exposure: educational intervention based on BASNEF Model
Educational intervention based on the BASNEF Model
cohort: 140 nulliparous women in their last trimester of pregnancy in Khomain County
finding: The educational intervention based on the BASNEF Model was effective in reducing the cesarean section rate among pregnant women.
mod_finding: The educational intervention based on the BASNEF Model led to a significant decrease in cesarean section rates among the intervention group.
